subject: Request: pairing accelerator voucher with sandbox allowance for BlueHarbor cohort
messages:
From: Elena Park <elena@blueharbor.ai>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.inference>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.inference>
Date: Mon, 23 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: pairing accelerator voucher with sandbox allowance for BlueHarbor cohort

Hi Hannah,

Thanks again for the quick demo last week — the team at BlueHarbor is excited about moving a small pilot into your sandbox while we run our cohort projects. Two quick asks from our side:

1) Our accelerator t&c expect a per-founder sandbox credit (seat-based) on top of any single voucher issued to the company. Can Redwood stack the cohort voucher with sandbox allowances so each founder gets an independent sandbox seat?

2) We expect usage to spike during demo week (estimated token burst attached). If possible, we'd like a short (14 day) temporary top-up for the cohort rather than permanently increasing our committed tier.

I've attached a one-page forecast and a draft MOU that our program manager wants to use to document any exception.

Would appreciate a quick path to confirmation — demo is Sept 2 and we need something in writing for our sponsor.

Best,
Elena Park
Founder, BlueHarbor Labs
elena@blueharbor.ai

Attachments: BlueHarbor-usage-forecast.csv, MOU-draft.pdf

From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.inference>
To: Elena Park <elena@blueharbor.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.inference>
Date: Mon, 23 Aug 2026 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: pairing accelerator voucher with sandbox allowance for BlueHarbor cohort

Thanks Elena — appreciate the context and the forecast. Quick answers up front: we can usually allocate cohort vouchers at the org level, but stacking seat-level sandbox allowances alongside a voucher is an exceptions conversation that needs a short approvals loop with sales ops and finance.

We're happy to consider a temporary top-up for demo week (14 days) if it stays within our operational limits. Can you confirm:
- how many founders/seats need the sandbox allowance?
- approximate token peak per seat during demo week?
- is the MOU intended to be binding or just a record of the exception?

Looping in Ben to start pricing/approval — Ben, do we have a templated exception for cohort seat stacking? If not, can we propose a one-off top-up (N tokens) and a short escrow for billing reconciliation?

I'll hold off on final confirmation until we have Ben/finance sign-off, but aiming to get this resolved by Thu so Elena can share the paper with sponsors.

Best,
Hannah Schmitt
Director, Startup Partnerships
Redwood Inference

----Original attachments referenced by Elena----

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.inference>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.inference>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.inference>, Elena Park <elena@blueharbor.ai>
Date: Tue, 24 Aug 2026 11:29:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Request: pairing accelerator voucher with sandbox allowance for BlueHarbor cohort

Hannah — quick internal note and a recommended path: finance is generally comfortable with temporary top-ups (we treat them as grants and reconcile post-burst). Stacking an org-level voucher with per-seat sandbox allowances is less common because it can double-count consumption for billing/benchmarks, but we can do a controlled stack with these guardrails: 

- Limit stack to 5 seats max for this cohort (we'll require attendee list)
- Temporary sandbox top-up = 150k tokens total, 14 day window tied to demo week (expire automatically)
- Voucher remains unchanged but we'll add a metadata flag in billing that routes seat consumption to the temporary top-up first
- Require MOU signed by both parties acknowledging reconciliation terms and that any overage is charged at standard promo rate

If that sounds acceptable to Hannah/Elena I can spin up the exception and route to finance for a one-click approval. Laura — can you confirm whether this needs a written credit memo or if we should treat as an exception in HubSpot?

Ben Carter
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference

Attachment: draft-exception-terms.txt (internal stub)

From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.inference>
To: Elena Park <elena@blueharbor.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.inference>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.inference>
Date: Wed, 26 Aug 2026 15:03:00 -0700
Subject: Confirmed: cohort stacking + 14-day sandbox top-up (BlueHarbor)

Elena — good news. We ran this by ops and finance and can approve the limited exception for BlueHarbor's Sept demo week. Summary of what we've approved below; full terms will be posted to HubSpot and I'll attach the signed MOU once returned: 

- Cohort stacking: up to 5 founder seats will receive a sandbox seat allowance stacked on top of the org voucher. Please provide the attendee list by EOD Aug 28.
- Temporary top-up: 150,000 tokens allocated to the cohort (14-day window starting Sept 1, auto-expire Sept 15). Consumption will be billed to the top-up first; any overage will be charged at the agreed promo rate.
- Documentation: sign the attached MOU and return via DocuSign link. We'll also create a HubSpot exception record (BH-2026-0823-ACCEL).

Links & attachments: HubSpot record: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/record/67890
Drive folder with MOU & forecast: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c4d5e6f

I'll add Laura to the HubSpot note so we have a credit memo if accounting needs one. If anything changes on your end, flag it ASAP. Congrats to the cohort — excited to see the demos.

Best,
Hannah Schmitt
Director, Startup Partnerships
Redwood Inference

Attachments: MOU-draft.pdf
DocuSign: https://docusign.com/link/placeholder/blueharbor-mou
